violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The front of the stand-up freezer and the sides of the hot fry holding unit have excess grease splatter and need to be cleaned. The fan over the prep line is covered in dust and needs to be cleaned.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single-use cups and lids were covered in overspray from the drink machines.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. The hand wash sink next to the front counter had ice and cherries in it, dumped from a cup.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer need to be swept.

General premises. — --Items unnecessary for the operation and maintenance of the food establishment were being stored on the premises. Excess equipment and maintenance items were being stored in the dry storage area and made it very cluttered.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of the reach-in cooler next to the microwave needs to be cleaned.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of single-use cup lids were being stored on the ground in the dry storage area.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Both of the paper towel dispensers were not working at the time of inspection.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors throughout the kitchen and the walk-in cooler/freezer need to be cleaned more thoroughly.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor in the walk-in cooler and wall behind the pop system need to be cleaned.
